name: Candelaria (Valle del Cauca, Colombia)
description: Horizontal bicolour of yellow and green.
history: Municipal flag of Candelaria, a municipality in the department of Valle del Cauca, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor. Spanish Wikipedia records the flag as adopted on 12 June 1954 (Decreto 034).
